corrections.title: Clarify the 3v3 Grand Inquisitor TRAYA note with a documented historical lineup
corrections.rationale: Replaces the generic 'Strong' note with condition-specific historical guidance for the documented Grand Inquisitor / Ninth Sister / Seventh Sister defence. Owner-agreed content (Group 4C, issue #37). Notes only: no tier, bannerScore, undersize, counter identity or required-member change. Sion appears in the note only; TRAYA still requires Darth Traya and Darth Nihilus.

evidence.supports: Owner-agreed exact note text for the 3v3 Grand Inquisitor TRAYA counter (C01).

Page 'Last update: January 16th 2026' lists Grand Inquisitor / Ninth Sister / Seventh Sister versus Darth Traya / Darth Nihilus / Darth Sion at 100%, 79 wins and 0 losses. Verified directly from the page's portrait titles and win/loss counts in this session.
Exact before/after Grand Inquisitor row for review item C01 of CR-2026-10-11-01.
